fusions.name: Starter's Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a fast pellet that deals 8 piercing damage, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds after. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Buckshot Report
fusions.desc: A blast of shot that deals 28 piercing damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles long, ignoring armour. You move 30% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Wide-Eyed Range
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Jumpy Nerves
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
